topics.description: The topic of Medicaid fraud is trending due to the recent arrest of two Minnesota women charged in a $21 million Medicaid fraud scheme. This scheme involved the misuse of state funds meant for autism services.
topics.reason: The large amount of money involved and the fact that it involves a vulnerable population (autism services) are reasons for the high heat.
